node.title: Re: Ampersand changes behavior of subroutine
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I've noticed that my subroutine behaves differently depending on if I call it with an "&" character or not.

Although the others have already explained that in this case it's because of the way [doc://sort] works, I just wanted to briefly address the more general question about calling subs with and without an ampersand: [id://1228225|see this node for an explanation].
